title: A day in London

exercises.title: A DAY IN LONDON
pages: Tom arrived in London early in the morning. He had never visited the city before, so everything was new and exciting. The sky was grey, but Tom didn't mind. He put on his jacket, took the map and left his small hotel in King's Cross.

First, he walked to the British Museum. It was free to enter, and Tom spent two hours looking at old statues and Egyptian mummies. A friendly guard told him: «You must also see the reading room. It is very beautiful.» Tom thanked him and went inside.

In the afternoon, Tom was hungry. He bought fish and chips and sat on a bench in Trafalgar Square. Pigeons tried to steal his lunch. «I have never eaten fish and chips before,» Tom thought, «and now I am eating it with pigeons. London is strange and wonderful.»

exercises.prompt: Why did everything feel new to Tom?
options: He had never visited London before.
exercises.explain: В первом абзаце: He had never visited the city before. Поэтому город был для него новым.

options: the guard gave him a gift
exercises.explain: Во втором абзаце free to enter означает бесплатный вход, а не свободное время.

exercises.prompt: A friendly guard ___ him about the reading room.
exercises.explain: Tell somebody about something: told him about the reading room. Say требует другой конструкции: said something to him.
В последнем абзаце голуби пытались украсть его обед: tried to steal his lunch.

exercises.prompt: Переведите: Он рассказал мне о музее.
exercises.answer: He told me about the museum.

exercises.prompt: Переведите: Я никогда не был в Риме. Используйте Present Perfect.
exercises.answer: I have never been to Rome.
exercises.explain: Have + been; never показывает отсутствие опыта до сейчас.

objective: Понять рассказ о поездке и назвать действия.
